snippet.title: PSX Longplay [402] Autobahn Raser II
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: NPI

Released only in Europe, more precisely Germany. It was released in English as A2 Racer II, but only for the PC.

 Played with the Smart... I mean the Clever car for most of the game only to save money to buy a better car, but in the final level I had to buy a cheaper one because it was cheaper to do that than to repair the better car. After the trophy screen at the end, the game loops from the beginning, without credits screen or anything. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
